title: Verdantis - Satellite Moisture & Vegetation Monitoring
description: Verdantis - a Sentinel-2 based pilot for monitoring forestry/agriculture plot moisture, vegetation vigour, and structural vegetation breaks.

hero.tagline: Verdantis turns free Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery into a plot-level view of vegetation vigour (NDVI), canopy/soil moisture (NDWI & NDMI), and structural change - built as a client-facing pilot for a single forestry plot, reusable for any shapefile.
hero.photo_alt: True-color satellite view of the plot

features.title: Four views into the same plot
features.lede: Each product below is generated locally from the same Sentinel-2 pipeline and openly documented - none of the thresholds are calibrated operational alerts yet, they're pilot starting points meant to be checked against field observations before driving real decisions.

historical.title: Historical Pilot
historical.desc: Up to 5 years of monthly NDVI/NDWI/NDMI time series, a frequency + magnitude "where does the plot lose water most" map, and ERA5 temperature + precipitation overlays.

explorer.title: Sector Explorer
explorer.desc: Interactive map - the plot split into 5×5-pixel sectors, toggle NDWI/NDMI, click any sector for its own moisture-vs-temperature history.

monitoring.title: Monitoring & Alerts
monitoring.desc: Current weekly NDVI/NDWI/NDMI conditions, a scrubbable monthly imagery view of the last year, and BFAST-style structural break detection - harvest, dieback, or land-use change flagged in the raw NDVI series.
